(5) Mobile 390x844: bottom nav renders all 5 (bottomnav-dashboard/inbox/workflows/tasks/ask) with scrollWidth==innerWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow). Regression 38/38: auth, dashboard, decision approve/reject flows, tasks CRUD, workflows next-stage guard (skip-stage 400, backward 400, owner-gate 403), voice owner-gate (sales/production/finance 403), brain search, Ask AI, digest mocked.
